title: Lemon Posset
description: Three ingredients, one pan, and no setting agent — the acid in the lemon does all of it. Sets to something between a custard and a curd in four hours.
notes: The ratio matters more than the technique. Too little lemon and it never sets; too much and it splits.

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.note: zest of two, juice of all three

steps.text: Bring the heavy cream, sugar, and lemon zest to a boil, stirring until the sugar has dissolved.
steps.tip: Use a bigger pan than seems necessary — cream climbs fast once it goes.

steps.text: Boil steadily for three minutes, watching it does not go over.
Take off the heat, stir in the lemon juice, and leave it to thicken slightly.
Strain out the zest and pour into four glasses.
